knownDeltas: The href host is the in-process test server (http://localhost); Esri's sample href points at sampleserver6. The export envelope (width/height/extent/scale) is the parity contract.
Rendered pixels are engine-native and covered structurally by mapserver-export-image, never byte-compared here.

Live Esri expands the export frame to the image aspect (verified 2026-10-10 against sampleserver6 SampleWorldCities: bbox -20,20,40,70 at 200x150 answers xmin -23.33/xmax 43.33); the host resizes the projected extent the same way per the spec note, and the adjusted extent is what f=json reports.

Scale stays degrees-based (frame width / image width at 96dpi); live Esri answers a meters-based scale for geographic CRS (140244747.28 here). That pre-existing scale divergence is unchanged by the framing fix.
name: mapserver-export
notes: Export envelope (MapServer/export?f=json): the doc-pattern bbox/size/format over the published map; the replay pins the image href plus dimensions, extent and scale. Live re-verified 2026-10-10: Esri expands the shorter side, centered, to the image aspect.
source: Esri REST docs: Export Map (https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/services-reference/enterprise/export-map.htm); bbox/bboxSR/imageSR/size/format pattern
